description: Checks whether a company can say who answers for each AI agent it runs, on 10 questions (list of agents, named owner, written limits, sign-off above limits, log, off-switch, notice to staff and candidates, human review, cost, training), based on the Air Canada chatbot ruling, UAE data protection law, DIFC Regulation 10, the UAE AI Charter and the EU AI Act. Give answers as 10 digits in question order: 2 = yes, 1 = partly, 0 = no (e.g. 1210010110). Returns the score out of 20, the band (0-7 Exposed, 8-14 Building, 15-20 In control) and an action list with the No answers first. Call with no answers to get the questions. English, Spanish or Arabic. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/ai-agent-accountability-check/

answers.description: 10 digits, each 0, 1 or 2, in question order (optional)

name: ai_agent_accountability_check
title: AI agent accountability check
